info.description: Backend API for the Medha platform. V2 Authentication (OTP-based), User Profiles, Events, Matching, and more.
info.title: Medha API V2

get.description: Returns the public keys in JWKS format for verifying JWTs issued by Medha.
Retrieve overview charts, growth indexes, user states breakdown, and posting analytics.
Overview metrics for assignment engine and leads.
Returns all event-pandit matches with details.

post.description: Manually create a new booking (match).

put.description: Update fields of a booking (match).

delete.description: Deletes a booking from the database.

get.description: Returns a list of buckets managed by the system.
Returns a list of objects in the specified bucket.

post.description: Uploads a file to the specified bucket.

delete.description: Deletes a specific object from a managed bucket.

get.description: Returns object count and total size for a managed bucket.
Returns the public accessibility URL for a specific object key.
Returns all festival logos from the database.

post.description: Manually create a new festival logo record.
Generates a presigned URL for uploading a festival logo.

put.description: Update festival logo fields.

delete.description: Deletes a festival logo from the database.

get.description: Returns all chat conversations with metadata.

post.description: Manually create a new chat conversation.

put.description: Update fields of a conversation.

delete.description: Deletes a conversation from the database.

get.description: Returns up to 500 events from the database.

post.description: Manually create a new event record.

get.description: Returns pandits matching the event's ceremony type and location, excluding already-pushed pandits.

put.description: Update event fields. Returns 404 if event not found.

delete.description: Soft-deletes an event. Returns 404 if event not found.

get.description: Returns official posts authored by Medha App with cursor pagination.
get.summary: List official Medha App feed posts

post.description: Creates a new post in the feed authored by the verified official Medha App system user.
post.summary: Create a Medha App official feed post

get.description: Retrieves details of a specific official post by UUID.
get.summary: Get official Medha App feed post

put.description: Modifies content, image, or tags of an existing official feed post.
put.summary: Update official Medha App feed post

delete.summary: Delete official Medha App feed post

get.description: Fetch all platform fee configurations.

post.description: Create a new platform fee configuration.

put.description: Update an existing platform fee configuration.

get.description: Returns all festivals from the database.

200.description: List of festivals with id, festival, date

post.description: Manually create a new festival record.

put.description: Update festival fields. Returns 404 if festival not found.

delete.description: Deletes a festival record. Returns 404 if festival not found.

get.description: Fetch all job leads with optional filters.

post.description: Admin manually assigns a Pandit to an event.

get.description: Fetch all job leads for a specific event.

post.description: Transition lead to accepted, create match and conversation workspace, and log the platform fee.

get.description: Fetch a single job lead by ID.

put.description: Admin updates the status of a job lead.

post.description: Authenticate admin user and return an access token.
Generates a presigned URL for uploading media to S3-compatible storage.

get.description: Get monetization dashboard metrics, total revenue, and active ads count.

post.description: Grant premium benefits, badge, and configure premium features JSON block.

get.description: Returns health status for API, PostgreSQL, S3 storage, and total resource counts.
Returns all notifications across all users.

post.description: Manually create a notification for a specific user.

put.description: Update fields of a notification.

delete.description: Deletes a notification from the database.

get.description: Returns panchanga records within a date range.

post.description: Manually create a new panchanga record.

put.description: Update panchanga fields.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a panchanga record by setting deleted_at.

get.description: Returns up to 500 non-deleted social posts with author metadata.

post.description: Manually create a social feed post.

put.description: Update social feed post fields. Returns 404 if post is not found.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a social feed post. Returns 404 if post is not found.

get.description: Returns CPU, memory, goroutines, and OS information.
Returns counts for users, events, festivals, panchanga, and logos.
Returns up to 500 users from the database.

post.description: Manually create a new user record.

put.description: Update user fields. Returns 404 if user not found.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a user. Returns 404 if user not found.

post.description: Bypasses OTP verification for development. Accepts either a role ("pandit"/"yajman") or a direct phone number from the dev account list. Returns a real JWT + refresh token pair at zero cost.

403.description: Disabled in production or phone not allowed

get.description: Returns all users in the database that have a phone number, sorted by role then first name. Only available in non-production environments.

post.description: Revokes the given refresh token, effectively logging the user out of that session. Idempotent — calling with an already-revoked token returns 200.
Uses a valid refresh token to obtain a new access + refresh token pair. The old refresh token is revoked (rotation).
Sends a 6-digit OTP via SMS to the given phone number. Rate limited to 3 requests per hour per number.

get.description: Validates the 6-digit OTP. Creates a new user if not found, or logs in the existing user. Returns the unified auth response. Note: This is an HTTP GET request, so phone and otp must be sent as query parameters.
Returns all available ceremony types with display names, logos, and categories. Supports optional fuzzy search via ?q= parameter that matches against slug, display name, category, and description.
Returns a list of seeded cities within a given radius, sorted by distance.
Searches seeded cities by name. Falls back to MapMyIndia autocomplete if not found in database.
Returns the user's conversation inbox sorted by most recent activity.

post.description: Starts a new conversation thread between participants. If a direct conversation already exists, returns the existing one.

get.description: Returns a conversation with its participants. Caller must be a participant.
Returns paginated messages in a conversation, newest first. Caller must be a participant.

post.description: Sends a message to a conversation via REST. For real-time use WebSocket instead.

put.description: Marks all messages in the conversation as read for the caller.

post.description: Creates a new ceremony event at the given location. Use ceremony_type="custom" with custom_ceremony_name and custom_ceremony_description for rituals not present in the catalog, such as Gudli Pooja.

get.description: Returns paginated list of events created by the authenticated user. Supports cursor-based pagination.

Returns events near the given coordinates. Supports radius-based search (lat/lng/radius_km) or bounding box (min_lat/max_lat/min_lng/max_lng).
NOTE: distance_km is calculated relative to the authenticated user's stored home location if available.
Returns event details by UUID.

put.description: Updates an existing event. Only the event owner can update it. All fields are optional.

delete.description: Cancels an existing event. Only the event owner can cancel it.

get.description: Returns paginated pandit interests for a specific event. Only the event owner can view.
Returns paginated posts from the community feed, newest first. Supports cursor-based pagination for use with Paging 3. Pass the `next_cursor` from the previous response as `cursor` for the next page.

parameters.description: Number of posts per page (1-50, default 10)
parameters.name: limit

post.description: Creates a new post in the community feed. At least one of `content` or `image_urls` must be provided.

get.description: Returns paginated posts authored by a specific user. Supports cursor-based pagination.
Returns a single post by its UUID, including like state for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a community feed post if the authenticated user is the author.

403.description: Not authorized to delete this post

post.description: Adds a like from the authenticated user to the specified post.

delete.description: Removes the authenticated user's like from the specified post.

400.description: Invalid post ID or not liked

post.description: Creates a new help/support conversation for the authenticated user.
Allows a pandit to express interest in a yajman's event.

get.description: Returns paginated list of interests expressed by the authenticated pandit.

put.description: Allows a yajman to accept a pandit's interest (moving it to connected, unlocking chat).
Allows a yajman to book a specific connected pandit (moving interest to accepted, rejecting others, marking event booked).
Allows a yajman to accept or reject a pandit's interest in their event.
Allows a pandit to withdraw their interest, marking themselves unavailable.

get.description: Pandit views their incoming job leads.

put.description: Pandit accepts a job lead. Platform fee is charged.
Pandit declines a job lead. No fee is charged.

get.description: Returns nearby points of interest (temples, venues) using MapMyIndia Atlas. Requires a valid JWT bearer token.
Returns the formatted address and location details for given latitude and longitude coordinates. Requires a valid JWT bearer token.
Returns step-by-step driving directions between coordinates. Requires a valid JWT bearer token.
Returns up to 10 place suggestions matching the query string using MapMyIndia Atlas API. Requires a valid JWT bearer token.
Returns a valid access token for client-side MapMyIndia SDK use. Requires a valid JWT bearer token.
Returns paginated matches for the authenticated user (as yajman or pandit).
Returns the full details of a match including both parties' info. Only the yajman or pandit can access.

put.description: Transitions a match from 'created' to 'matched'. Only the yajman can accept.
Transitions a match from 'matched' to 'active' (ceremony in progress).
Transitions a match from 'active' to 'completed'. Only the yajman can complete.

post.description: Allows a yajman to rate and comment on a pandit's service after match completion. Returns updated badge info.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of notifications for the authenticated user, including unread count.

post.description: Associates a push token (FCM or APNs) with the user's account for the given platform.

delete.description: Marks a device push token as inactive.

put.description: Marks all of the authenticated user's unread notifications as read.
Updates a single notification's status to read.

get.description: Returns full Hindu calendar details for a given date (YYYY-MM-DD). No authentication required.
Returns upcoming Hindu festivals from today, ordered by date. Use `limit` to control results (default 100, max 500). No authentication required.

parameters.description: Max number of festivals to return (default 100)
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Returns full Hindu calendar details for every day between `from` and `to` (YYYY-MM-DD, max 366 days). No authentication required.
Returns the Hindu calendar details for today (IST). No authentication required.
Returns a paginated list of pandits near a location. Supports filtering by availability, tradition, and ceremony type.
Returns the authenticated pandit's full professional profile merged with their user info. Returns 403 if the user is not a pandit and 404 if no profile has been set up yet.

403.description: Forbidden — user is not a pandit

put.description: Creates or updates the professional profile of the authenticated pandit. Only users with role=pandit can call this endpoint. All fields are optional — send only what you want to update.

400.description: Validation error — invalid availability_status, service_radius_km out of range, or field too long

403.description: Forbidden — only pandit accounts can update a pandit profile

get.description: Returns the list of serviceable cities configured by the authenticated pandit.

put.description: Replaces the pandit's home and additional serviceable cities.

get.description: Returns the professional profile of a specific pandit by their user UUID.
Returns the current badge tier, average rating, and ceremony counts for a pandit.
Returns safe public details of a user profile by username. This endpoint is public (no JWT required).

post.description: Confirms that the client successfully uploaded a file via a pre-signed URL and links it in the database if applicable.

403.description: Forbidden (key does not belong to user)

post.description: Generates a pre-signed PUT URL for uploading media to S3-compatible storage directly.

get.description: Returns active, eligible official stories for the authenticated viewer, deterministically ordered.
get.summary: List active official stories for the viewer

post.description: Idempotently records that the authenticated viewer has seen this story.

404.description: Story not found or not eligible

get.description: Checks if a username is already taken. This endpoint is public.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the authenticated user's account and all associated data.

500.description: Failed to delete account. Please try again.

get.description: Returns the currently stored home location for the authenticated user. Used to seed the map on startup.

put.description: Updates the user's geographic location natively translating to PostGIS coordinates. Returns the full profile.

get.description: Returns the current user's profile including pandit profile if applicable.

post.description: Sets the user's first name, last name, and role, marking the profile as complete.
